description: Different model profiles should preserve misplaced coverage findings when a split placement recommendation is surfaced in top project findings.

lockedFields.reason: The placement-only fixture should surface one finding instead of inventing weak coverage findings from minimal targets.
The split recommendation must be counted as a placement finding in the repo-level report.
Escaped integration coverage should be reported as misplaced coverage, not missing coverage.
Integration-level cross-owner tests should stay split recommendations.
The current app-level owner must remain visible for review.
The package owner of the exercised behavior must remain visible for review.
The report should expose the repository-relative misplaced test path.
Project finding IDs should wrap stable placement IDs for downstream review links.

unexpectedVariations: placement finding hidden from top findings
minimal fixture target reported as weak coverage
missing current or suggested project owner
